basic_details.job_title: District Panchayat Kondagaon Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Accountant, Program Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Panchayat Kondagaon is inviting offline applications by registered post or speed post to the Office of the Collector, Zila Panchayat Kondagaon, Room No. 35, General Branch, with the last date to apply being 6 November 2026. This recruitment drive offers a total of 8 contract vacancies for Program Officer (1), Assistant Programmer (2), and Accountant (5) posts in Kondagaon. Applicants must be residents of Chhattisgarh with desired educational qualifications as per the rules of Vikas Bharat-Rozgar Evam Aajeevika Mission (Gramin), and pay is provided as per mission norms under advertisem

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent in a sealed envelope via registered post or speed post to the following address: Office of the Collector, Zila Panchayat Kondagaon, Room No. 35, General Branch, Kondagaon, Chhattisgarh Applications sent in person, via email, electronic media, or any other medium will not be accepted. The last date to submit applications is 06.11.2026 by 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Panchayat Kondagaon recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications is 6 November 2026 up to 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 8 contract vacancies are available across Program Officer, Assistant Programmer, and Accountant posts.

faq.question: Q3. Are these posts permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: These positions are sanctioned on a contract basis under the Vikas Bharat-Rozgar Evam Aajeevika Mission (Gramin).

faq.question: Q4. Can applications be submitted via email or in person?
faq.answer: No. Applications submitted in person, via email, electronic media, or any other medium will not be accepted. Applications must be sent strictly via registered post or speed post.
